definitions.gloss: kaeriten; marks showing reading order in kanbun
definitions.explanation: Small marks, such as the "re" mark and the numbered "one, two" marks, written beside classical Chinese text so that it can be read in Japanese word order.

examples.japanese: {返|かえ}り{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{返|かえ}り{点|てん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: In class we learned how to read the reading-order marks.
Kanbun is read by following the marks, going back from a lower character to a higher one.

notes:
USAGE:
Taught in high-school classical Japanese (⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧) classes. Together with ⟦{送|おく}り{仮名|がな}→送り仮名：15047_okurigana⟧, the marks turn a Chinese text into Japanese.
